name: 灌溉均匀度（克里斯琴森系数）计算

map.灌溉均匀度（克里斯琴森系数）计算是做什么的？: What does Irrigation Uniformity (Christiansen's Coefficient) Calculator do?
map.如何使用灌溉均匀度（克里斯琴森系数）计算？: How do I use Irrigation Uniformity (Christiansen's Coefficient) Calculator?
map.灌溉均匀度（克里斯琴森系数）计算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Irrigation Uniformity (Christiansen's Coefficient) Calculator best for?
map.输入各测点收集水量，计算克里斯琴森均匀系数 Cu，评估喷灌/滴灌均匀性。: Enter collected water at each sampling point to compute Christiansen uniformity Cu and assess sprinkler/drip uniformity.
map.克里斯琴森均匀系数：Cu = [1 − Σ|xi − x̄| ÷ (n × x̄: Christiansen uniformity coefficient: Cu = [1 - Σ|xi - x̄| / (n x x̄)] x 100%. xi is each point's collected water, x̄ is the mean, n is the number of points. Cu closer to 100% means more uniform; sprinkler usually >=80%, drip >=90%; large deviation indicates uneven pipe pressure or clogged drippers, used for irrigation system acceptance and uniformity diagnosis.
map.测点收集水量（用逗号、空格或换行分隔，单位：mL 或 mm）: Sampled water amounts (comma / space / newline separated, unit mL or mm)
map.测点数量建议不少于 16 个，分布均匀覆盖灌溉区域: Recommend at least 16 sampling points, evenly covering the area
map.Cu ≥ 85% 认为均匀性良好，70%–85% 一般，<70% 需检查喷头/滴: Cu >= 85% good, 70%-85% fair, <70% check nozzle/dripper clogging or pressure
map.CU = 1 − Σ|x_i − x̄| / (n × x̄)：实测值与均值偏差: CU = 1 - Σ|x_i - x̄| / (n x x̄): smaller deviation from mean means more uniform.
map.CU ≥ 0.85 为优，0.75~0.85 可接受，低于需调喷头/压力。: CU >= 0.85 excellent, 0.75-0.85 acceptable, below needs nozzle/pressure adjustment.
map.9 个雨量筒收集量均值 x̄=10 mm，各筒偏差绝对值之和 Σ|x_i−x̄|: 9 rain gauges avg x̄=10 mm, sum of absolute deviations Σ|x_i-x̄|=9 mm, so CU = 1 - 9/(9x10) = 1 - 0.1 = 0.90, excellent uniformity.
map.CU 和分布均匀系数 DU 一样吗？: Is CU the same as distribution uniformity DU?
map.不同。CU 用全部测点均值，DU（如 Christiansen 的变体或低四分位: Different. CU uses the mean of all points; DU (e.g. Christiansen variant or lower-quartile DU_lq) uses the lowest 1/4 mean, stricter and better reflecting the worst-area supply.
map.先查系统压力是否均衡、喷头是否堵塞或型号不一、支管首末端压力降。多数情况是压力不: First check pressure balance, nozzle clogging/model mismatch, and main-branch pressure drop. Most cases are uneven pressure or nozzle wear.
map.克里斯琴森均匀系数（Christiansen's Uniformity Coef: Christiansen's Uniformity Coefficient (Cu) is a common metric for sprinkler, micro-spray, and drip water-distribution uniformity. This tool quickly computes Cu from field-measured point volumes and gives an evaluation.
map.支持任意数量的测点数据批量输入: Supports batch input of any number of sampling points
map.自动计算平均值、标准差、变异系数与 Cu: Auto-computes mean, std dev, coefficient of variation, and Cu
